blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Visayan Electric Co. will implement scheduled power interruptions in portions of Cebu City and nearby areas through October 10 as crews carry out maintenance, repairs, and distribution-system upgrades. The utility has scheduled outages in parts of Cebu City, Talisay City, Minglanilla, San Fernando, and Naga City on October 2 and 3, followed by a separate Cebu City schedule covering October 4 to 10. Some interruptions will last up to nine hours, while additional short-duration outages will affect areas where crews will conduct hotspot corrections and other preventive work.
